rows.grounds: compound: bhava-abdhi-bheda-racanā; feminine epithet describing one who arranges the breaking of the ocean of existence
compound: bhava-abdhi-bheda-roṣitā; feminine epithet describing one enraged in or by the breaking of the ocean of existence

items.question: What roles of arrangement and fierce anger does the goddess assume in shattering the ocean of worldly existence?
premises: The goddess arranges the breaking of the ocean of existence.
The goddess is enraged in the act of breaking the ocean of existence.
Both deliberate arrangement and fierce anger operate in the rupture of worldly bondage.
items.inference: The goddess embodies both the orchestrating design and the fierce force that shatter the ocean of worldly existence.
uncertainties: The exact force of roṣitā (angered at, angered by, or angered in the act of breaking) is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: She is the one who arranges the breaking of the ocean of existence, and she is the one enraged in breaking the ocean of existence.
